description: Low-level HL perp copy trade update (prefer update_hl_copy_trade_settings / pause_hl_copy_trade / resume_hl_copy_trade / delete_hl_copy_trade). Every field is rewritten from this payload, so pass the full current config. isDelete=true permanently deletes the configuration; perp positions it opened are NOT closed and their TP/SL orders are NOT cancelled. isChangeStatus=true TOGGLES active/paused relative to the stored state. isDelete and isChangeStatus cannot both be true.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

isChangeStatus.description: Toggle active/paused relative to the stored state

isDelete.description: Permanently delete the configuration (positions stay open)

name: update_hl_copy_trade
